sections.title: The service
sections.body: Exams connects candidates who want to book an exam seat with assistants who book it for them. Exams does not sell seats and is not affiliated with exam centres.

sections.title: Price
sections.body: Exams sets the price for each centre and level, and shows it before you commit. It includes the assistant's share and a platform commission.

sections.title: Your exam-centre credentials
sections.body: They are encrypted, visible only to the assistant who takes your request during the booking, then deleted. Change your password after the booking.

sections.title: Payment and disputes
sections.body: After the booking, you pay the assistant and the platform directly. If you disagree, Exams reviews the evidence and decides. An unpaid booking or an abusive dispute can lead to a suspension.

sections.title: Your data
sections.body: We only collect what the booking and its follow-up need. You can ask us to export or delete your data.
